prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Edit this existing approval-preview portrait of the adult Herdeiro do Culto. Keep the SAME person, same narrow long face, long hair shape and length, clean-shaven jaw, slender neck, slim shoulders, head coordinates, body proportions, square canvas and curved bust crop. Apply these three specific revisions:

HAIR: his long hair must read unequivocally BLACK. Replace the broad warm-white hair locks with predominantly solid near-black ink masses, keeping only a few very narrow muted ivory/soft-charcoal strand highlights and sparse edge accents to preserve readability. At least 85–90% of the visible hair should be dark. No white, blond or gray locks. Preserve the original hairstyle and flowing outline.

EXPRESSION: make him clearly more malevolent, calculating and sinister while retaining the same facial anatomy and subtle caricature. Narrow the eyes slightly into an intent watchful gaze, angle the brows into a restrained menacing arch, and give him a small cold asymmetric CLOSED-MOUTH smirk. He should look quietly dangerous and self-assured rather than tired, sad or friendly. Keep normal dark pupils. No fangs, monstrous grin, visible teeth, glowing eyes, eye makeup, scars or aging.

CLOTHING: he ALWAYS has negative honor, but his clothing is elegant, intact and meticulously maintained. Make the dark robe visibly well tailored, with crisp narrow folded lapels, smooth expensive cloth, controlled long folds and a small fine aged-gold clasp. Add only a restrained thin gold edge detail on the collar. No rags, patches, stitches, tears, dirt, fraying or signs of poverty. His darker moral state is expressed through composure, quality and luxury, not ruined clothing. This remains the INITIAL appearance, with no large cult flame or red ceremonial mantle yet.

Preserve the exact source's thick irregular black ink, economical hand hatching, simplified facial drawing, subtle paper grain and warm near-white #F9EEDD SKIN tone. Do not darken, gray, yellow or realistically recolor his skin. Keep the same small aged-gold palette accents; no new colors. He must stay in the existing heir cast style, not photorealism, anime, 3D or a modern gothic outfit. Keep the fully transparent alpha background and clean margins; no frame, scenery, parchment sheet, halo, text or drop shadow.
